messages:
anya_pm: Quick sync — dropping a compact PRD fragment for the "metering brackets" work. need decisions on pricing semantics, API shape, and launch must-haves. who can weigh in? :wave:
sam_prod: On it. main customer ask is an easy-to-explain banded pricing (low/med/high) + per-minute smoothing. they want predictable monthly cost for usage spikes.
ben_eng: A few constraints from runtime: continuous batching makes strict per-second rate enforcement tricky. we can enforce soft burst windows + hard token caps per minute. suggests: hard cap (tokens/min) + burst allowance (tokens/10s).
olga_research: Can we surface quality degradation risk when quantization kicks in at lower tiers? customers need a signal if they opt into cheaper quant profiles.
louis_sales: +1. Sales needs deterministic messaging: "Tier A = SLO X, Tier B = SLO Y" so legal can map to invoices. also ask: will overages auto-bill or block? customers differ.
anya_pm: Good. Drafting acceptance criteria now. Early list: 1) API to read/write tenant limits 2) UI to show current bracket + projected monthly cost 3) Metering must align with billing (per-token) within 0.5% monthly variance 4) Safe fallback policy when SLO breached (circuit to cheaper model or fail-open) 5) Audit logs for limit changes. thoughts?
ben_eng: Implementation notes: prefer single resource endpoint /v1/tenants/:id/limits. proposal:
```
PUT /v1/tenants/:id/limits
{ "bracket": "standard|business|enterprise", "tokens_per_min": 120000, "burst_tokens": 5000, "billing_mode": "auto_overage|block" }
```
we can validate tokens_per_min server-side and apply a token-bucket enforcement in the serving mesh.
san_prod: tiny nit: use "billing_action" instead of billing_mode. avoids confusion with pricing plans.
olga_research: Edge-case: inter-region routing. If request routes to a fallback region with different cost, billing should still attribute to tenant home-region price. add that to acceptance criteria.
louis_sales: Another edge-case from pilot: shared API keys across projects. Need per-key overrides + per-tenant defaults. sales will push for per-key metering UI.
anya_pm: Adding to ACs: - per-key override supported - region attribution consistent - admin UI for overrides - rollback window for limit changes (5 min). anyone object?
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/limits-api -> staging (sha: f3a9b2) :rocket:
ben_eng: Also important: migration for existing customers. default mapping: current unlimited -> "business" bracket for billing calculations, but leave operational limits unchanged unless customer opts in. document migration plan in the PRD.
olga_research: QA checklist: synthetic spike tests, cross-region billing reconciliation test, quantization-quality smoke tests at each bracket.
louis_sales: Can we add a short explainer copy for marketing/checkout? 2 sentences that map bracket -> expected latency/quality/cost.
anya_pm: Will draft. final gating questions for launch: - legal signoff on SLAs - billing reconciliation within 24h acceptable? - API schema locked? please respond by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:
sam_prod: Agree with gating. for billing SLA let's aim for 12h reconciliation for GA, 24h ok for early access.
ben_eng: API schema looks fine. i'll open a tiny RFC PR with the PUT/GET examples and enforcement details.
anya_pm: Thanks — i'll add the migration notes + acceptance criteria to the PRD and ping legal. tagging @ben_eng @sam_prod for RFC review.
louis_sales: FYI: pilot customer "bluebox" asked for a temporary "burst credit" top-up coupon for launch week. we should support one-time credits in billing model.
anya_pm: Noted. adding as stretch goal. :thumbsup:
